source: AFL Tables (afltables.com) coaches index and coach pages
identity_rule: coach_path (coaches/<file>) is the coach's identity and profile_path the ONLY key a loader may use to link a coach to a player. A snapshot Coach string that is not exactly one index name_raw is refused; a profile_path that resolves to no canonical afltables identity is refused, never matched by name; a page with no Player Stats link is a coach-only person (player_id NULL, link_status unmatched).
